rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage (82/82 in scope agree: 37 fixtures, 45 partial records); the reply omits the project's guard for line 3e of zero or less, which only avoids a division by zero (i1116 p. 18, Line 3f: line 3d divided by line 3e, 'round off the result to at least four decimal places').
